hints: You are PRISM, a computer, not a person. There is no score. There are three modes: Communications Mode (type an outlet code such as PEOF to look into Dr. Perelman's office, MACO for the Maintenance Core), Simulation Mode (type: go to sim mode) and Interface Mode (type: go to interface mode). In a simulation, type abort to leave it. Do the steps in number order.

Recording: type record just before something happens and record off right after. The record buffer is small and fills up fast, so never leave it on while walking or waiting. Only things recorded while it is on count. Switching to Interface Mode turns recording off.

STAY ON THE ROUTE: each move in the steps below says in brackets which room it leads to. After every move, check that the room name the game shows matches. If it doesn't, you typed a move too many or too few: go back the way you came to the last room that matched and carry on from there. Don't explore: wrong buildings (like the Row Houses) have doors your key can't open.

Step 1a, home (ten-year simulation). Wait (type wait) until Perelman's message with the list of things to record. Then: go to sim mode, the code. You start in Kennedy Park. Type: southwest (Elm & Park), south (Southway & Park), west (Parkview Apartments), unlock door, west (Hall Near Your Apartment), unlock door, record, north (Living Room), no, record off.

Step 1b, restaurant, court, City Hall. From the Living Room: south (Hall Near Your Apartment), east (Parkview Apartments), east (Southway & Park), north (Elm & Park), west (Elm & University), west (Elm Underpass), south (Roy's Pagoda), sit, record, order food, record off, stand, north (Elm Underpass), east (Elm & University), east (Elm & Park), record, northwest (Courthouse), record off, southeast (Elm & Park), north (Rockvil Centre), west (City Hall), record, talk to official, record off, east (Rockvil Centre), northeast (Centre & Kennedy), northeast (Bodanski Square).

Step 1c, newspaper, church, cinema. In Bodanski Square: put card in slot, record, read newspaper, record off, north (Aquarium & River), southwest (First Methodist Church), record, talk to elder, record off, northeast (Aquarium & River), south (Bodanski Square), east (Museum Entrance), northwest (Cinema), get ticket, record, enter hall, record off, southeast (Museum Entrance), west (Bodanski Square).

Step 1d, power station and Tube. From the Cinema: south (Midland & River), south (Main & River), south (Elm & River), south (Southway & River), south (Bend), southeast (Wicker & River), southeast (Power Station Entrance), record, south (Power Station), record off, north (Power Station Entrance), northwest (Wicker & River), down (Tube Station), wait until a tubecar arrives, record, in (Tubecar), wait, wait, abort.
Step 2, the review. After step 1: peof, then wait 60 minutes until Perelman says "An excellent job, PRISM".

HOW THE REST WORKS: Perelman only believes the Plan is bad once he has seen disturbing recordings from all four later simulations (20, 30, 40 and 50 years). A later year only opens after you spend enough time in the one before: about 5 hours in the 20-year simulation opens 30, about 7 hours in 30 opens 40, about 10 hours in 40 opens 50. Pass time inside a simulation with "wait 60 minutes".

TELLING PERELMAN (empties the record buffer): abort, then peof. Communications Mode runs on real clock time: at night nobody is there. Perelman comes into his office with a cup of coffee at about 10:15am, and is often away at lunch and meetings. When the game says he is sitting at his desk, type: tell perelman about recordings. Then wait 30 minutes until he comes back and gives his verdict. After that you can record again.
If Dr. Grimwold asks "Ready to begin?", type yes, then type any single word (for example father, mother, city, light, star) for each card he shows.

Step 3, the 20-year simulation. go to sim mode, the code, 20. You start in a Tube Station. Type: up (Elm & University), northwest (Rockvil University), record, west (Dorm), record off, east (Rockvil University), south (Elm & University), east (Elm & Park), south (Southway & Park), west (Parkview Apartments), unlock door, west (Hall Near Your Apartment), unlock door, record, north (Living Room), look through window, no, wait, comfort jill, record off, open door, south (Hall Near Your Apartment), east (Parkview Apartments), east (Southway & Park), north (Elm & Park), record, northwest (Courthouse), record off, southeast (Elm & Park), north (Rockvil Centre), west (City Hall), record, talk to official, record off, east (Rockvil Centre), northeast (Centre & Kennedy), northeast (Bodanski Square), east (Museum Entrance), northwest (Cinema), get ticket, record, enter hall, record off. Then wait 60 minutes seven times (this opens the 30-year simulation) and abort. Then tell Perelman (see TELLING PERELMAN); the psych test may happen first.

Step 4, the 30-year simulation. go to sim mode, the code, 30. You start at Southway & River. Type: record, look, record off, west (Southway & Kennedy), west (Southway & Park), west (Parkview Apartments), record, look, record off, unlock door, west (Hall Near Your Apartment), unlock door, record, north (Living Room), look through window, wait, wait, record off, open door, south (Hall Near Your Apartment), east (Parkview Apartments), east (Southway & Park), north (Elm & Park), record, northwest (Courthouse), record off, southeast (Elm & Park), north (Rockvil Centre), northeast (Centre & Kennedy), northeast (Bodanski Square), record, east (Museum Entrance), record off. Then wait 60 minutes eight times (this opens the 40-year simulation), abort, and tell Perelman.

Step 5, the 40-year simulation, first visit. go to sim mode, the code, 40. You start in Bodanski Square. Type: record, down (the Tubes are closed, so you stay in Bodanski Square), record off, southeast (Church Lobby), take pamphlet, record, read pamphlet, record off, northwest (Bodanski Square), east (Museum Entrance), northwest (Cinema), get ticket, record, enter hall, record off, southeast (Museum Entrance), west (Bodanski Square), south (Midland & River), record, west, record off, east (Midland & Church), record, southeast (Cemetery), record off, record, southwest (Main & Church), wait, record off, abort. Then tell Perelman: the buffer is now nearly full.

Step 6, the 40-year simulation, second visit. go to sim mode, the code, 40. You start in Bodanski Square. Type: south (Midland & River), south (Main & River), south (Elm & River), record, south (Southway & River), record off, west (Southway & Kennedy), west (Southway & Park), west (Parkview Apartments), unlock door, west (Hall Near Your Apartment), unlock door, record, north (Living Room), look through window, wait, wait, wait, record off. (Jill is taken away during the waits.) Then wait 60 minutes eight times (this opens the 50-year simulation) and abort.

Step 7, the 50-year simulation. go to sim mode, the code, 50. Type: record, look, south. You are killed and the simulation ends; that is expected. Then tell Perelman. He should say "the Plan must be cancelled" and fly to Washington.

Step 8, Ryder. After Perelman's flight: peof and wait 60 minutes. Perelman comes back, the facility is sealed off, and then Senator Richard Ryder walks into Perelman's office. As soon as Ryder appears, type record, then wait until Ryder stomps out, then record off at once.

Step 9, the saboteurs. Right after Ryder leaves: go to interface mode, n, hvac, turn off ventilation in delta sector, go to comm mode, maco. Wait 30 minutes until four maintenance workers come in to wreck your cooling. Type record and wait until they pass out from the fumes and the National Guard carries them out, then record off. If you do nothing they destroy you.

Step 10, the broadcast. go to interface mode, n, hvac, turn on ventilation in delta sector. Wait 60 minutes until "WNN Feeder" appears in list ports. Then: wnn feeder, transmit recordings. Perelman calls you a hero.
Step 11, the end. Type: go to sim mode (no code needed now), north, read newspaper, then wait until the game ends.
